name: gis-kpi-dashboard-showcase
description: Auditable KPI performance dashboard (Next.js, Convex, TypeScript) as a static demo with synthetic data

paragraphs: ⚠️ Read-only showcase with synthetic demo data, for portfolio purposes. Every employee ("Demo Staff 01"…), employee ID (DEMO0001…), location, activity, score and evidence link in this repository is fictional. The production version runs on private HR data behind authentication and is not public. This copy is a static export: no sign-in, no backend, no uploads, and every change button is disabled.

Auditable, role-based KPI performance management for a utility's GIS team. Employees log evidence-backed work against their KPIs, reviewers approve evidence and periods, and a deterministic scoring engine turns approved inputs into reproducible, frozen score snapshots. Every quirk in the source KPI template (typos, unit mismatches, a blank frequency…) is surfaced as an admin-approvable data-quality issue rather than silently corrected.
